content.short: Nabla Finance is a single-sided AMM yield protocol where depositors avoid paired exposure.
content.description: Nabla Finance lets a provider deposit one asset in place of a pair, which removes impermanent loss from the position. The risk is absorbed instead by a USDT0 backstop pool that insures every swap pool and earns a share of all protocol fees in return. The interface reports volume, fees and average APR per pool alongside a coverage ratio showing how well each pool is insured. Positions are tracked on HyperEVM, with Monad also supported.
content.meta: Deposit one asset instead of a pair, moving divergence risk off the liquidity provider.
